rows: top row first; "#" = lit dot, "." = unlit; column 0 is the left edge; the ground is the bottom row

goblet.name: Goblet Squat
goblet.cue: hips drop between the heels, knees forward, torso tips just enough to keep the bell over mid-foot

rdl.name: Romanian Deadlift
rdl.cue: hips travel back, knees stay soft, back flat; the bar slides down the thighs

kbdl.name: KB Deadlift
kbdl.cue: standing tall with the bell hanging; knees and hips bend together and the bell goes to the floor between the feet

ohp.name: Shoulder Press
ohp.cue: seated, front view: bar from the collarbones to lockout overhead, elbows travel under the bar

row.name: Seated Row
row.cue: seated, feet braced, torso still; the handle comes to the ribs and the elbow passes behind

plank.name: Long-Lever Plank
plank.cue: a hold: elbows well ahead of the shoulders, one straight line from ear to heel. No pulse — just a breath: the hips settle a dot and come back

lunge.name: DB Reverse Lunge
lunge.cue: front foot planted, shin vertical; the rear foot steps back onto its toes and the rear knee drops under the hip

chest.name: Chest Press
chest.cue: lying on the bench, feet flat; the bar presses from the chest to a straight arm

pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
pulldown.cue: seated under the cable; the bar is pulled from full stretch to the collarbones, chest up

bridge.name: DB Glute Bridge
bridge.cue: shoulders on the floor, feet flat and close; the hips drive up until hip and knee are in line

calf.name: Standing Calf Raise
calf.cue: hand on the wall; the whole body rises on the toes — the heel lifts, the toe never does

gobletdeep.name: Deep Goblet Squat
gobletdeep.cue: same squat, hips all the way down to the calves, torso tips a little more

facepull.name: Face Pull
facepull.cue: split stance, cable at face height; the rope comes to the eyes with the elbow high and travelling behind

legcurl.name: Leg Curl
legcurl.cue: prone on the bench; the shin swings from flat to past vertical while the hips stay down

cph.name: Copenhagen Plank
cph.cue: side plank with the top leg on a bench and the bottom leg held up to meet it. A breath: the hips dip a dot and come back

deadbug.name: Dead Bug
deadbug.cue: on the back, arms up, knees at 90°; one arm reaches overhead as the opposite leg extends, low back stays down

sideplank.name: Side Plank
sideplank.cue: a hold on the forearm, one straight line from shoulder to heel, top arm to the ceiling. A breath, no pulse

calfstretch.name: Calf stretch
calfstretch.cue: hands on the wall, rear leg straight with the heel down; the hips move toward the wall

hipflexor.name: Hip flexor stretch
hipflexor.cue: half-kneeling, hand on the front knee; the hips glide forward while the torso stays tall

hamstring.name: Hamstring stretch
hamstring.cue: heel up on a box, toes up, leg straight; the hinge comes from the hips, back flat

figure4.name: Figure-4 stretch
figure4.cue: seated, ankle on the opposite knee; the torso folds forward over the shin

doorway.name: Doorway chest stretch
doorway.cue: forearm on the frame behind you; step through and let the chest lead

highknees.name: High knees
highknees.cue: on the toes; the knee drives to hip height while the arms run

carioca.name: Carioca
carioca.cue: front view, moving sideways; the trailing leg crosses in front, arms out for balance

legswing.name: Leg swings
legswing.cue: hand on the wall; the straight leg swings from behind to in front, torso quiet

askip.name: A-skips
askip.cue: a skip with a knee drive: the whole body hops off the toes as the knee comes up

walklunge.name: Walking lunges
walklunge.cue: a long stride; the rear knee drops toward the floor under the hip, front shin vertical

lowlunge.name: Low Lunge
lowlunge.cue: back knee down, shin along the mat; front knee over the ankle; torso tall, hands on the front thigh

halfsplit.name: Half Splits
halfsplit.cue: hips back over the rear knee, front leg straight with the toes up, hinge from the hip

chair.name: Chair Pose
chair.cue: a squat you hold: knees over the ankles, arms in line with the torso. Breath: the hips settle a dot

warrior2.name: Warrior II
warrior2.cue: front view: wide stance, one knee bent to 90, arms out in a T. Breath: the hips settle

pigeon.name: Pigeon
pigeon.cue: front shin folded across on the mat, back leg long behind, torso upright with a hand down

bridgepose.name: Bridge
bridgepose.cue: shoulders down, feet flat and close, hips up until hip and knee are in line, arms on the mat. Breath: the hips

seatedfold.name: Seated Forward Fold
seatedfold.cue: legs long, toes up, hinge forward with the hands to the shins. Bend the knees if the back rounds

supinetwist.name: Supine Twist
supinetwist.cue: on the back, knees folded over to one side, one arm long overhead. The rotation is toward the camera

downdog.name: Downward Dog
downdog.cue: hands and feet down, hips the apex, head between the arms. Breath: hips rise a dot, heels drop

puppy.name: Puppy Pose
puppy.cue: hips stacked over the knees, chest and arms down the mat, forehead down

thread.name: Thread the Needle
thread.cue: one shoulder on the mat with that arm along the floor; the free arm reaches to the ceiling

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.cue: prone on the forearms, elbows under the shoulders, chest lifted, legs long

cowface.name: Cow-Face Arms
cowface.cue: front view: one arm overhead and bent behind the head, the other bent behind the low back

childreach.name: Child’s Pose, side reach
childreach.cue: hips on the heels, forehead down, both arms walked to one side. The reach is toward the camera

savasana.name: Savasana
savasana.cue: flat on the back, toes up, arms by the sides. Breath: the chest, one dot

pushup.name: Push-up
pushup.cue: hands under the shoulders, one line from ear to heel; the chest drops to a fist off the floor and presses back

splitsquat.name: Split Squat
splitsquat.cue: a long stance, the rear heel up; the hips drop straight down until the rear knee is a fist off the floor

steplunge.name: Step-up
steplunge.cue: one foot flat on the step; the whole body rises onto it and the trailing foot lands beside

slrdl.name: Single-leg RDL Reach
slrdl.cue: balanced on one soft knee; the hips hinge back, the free leg reaches behind and the hand toward the floor

hipbridge.name: Single-leg Hip Bridge
hipbridge.cue: one foot flat, the other leg held long; the hips drive up until hip and knee are in line

bearcrawl.name: Bear Crawl
bearcrawl.cue: hands under the shoulders, knees an inch off the floor; opposite hand and foot step together

supermanhold.name: Superman Hold
supermanhold.cue: prone: arms and legs lifted off the floor, chin down. Breath: everything lifts a dot

hollow.name: Hollow Hold
hollow.cue: on the back, low back pressed down; shoulders and straight legs held off the floor, arms overhead. Breath: a dot higher

reversecrunch.name: Reverse Crunch
reversecrunch.cue: on the back, knees at ninety; the hips curl up off the floor and lower slowly, the low back kept down
